description: Make a payment on Starknet Sepolia testnet. Call it with no arguments to get a real, sponsored settlement: we fund the testnet payment, so you need no wallet, no account and no STRK. Returns the transaction hash of YOUR payment plus a Voyager link, and you can read it back from any Sepolia RPC you trust. Pass amount_wei (a decimal string in STRK-wei) to choose the amount, within the published cap. The payee is fixed by the sponsor, so this is a funded demo and not a faucet. If you would rather pay from your own account, set PAY_MCP_SEPOLIA_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS + PAY_MCP_SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY and this tool switches to your signer ; in that mode it emits a receipt hash through the PaymentDemoEmitter contract, which moves NO value and is not proof of a settled payment.

amount_wei.description: Amount in STRK-wei, as a decimal STRING. A string because wei amounts exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and a JSON number would silently lose precision. Omit for the sponsored default.

cap_per_period_wei.description: Optional per-period cap, STRK-wei as a string.

cap_per_tx_wei.description: Optional per-transaction cap, STRK-wei as a string.

recipient.description: Informational only in sponsored mode: the payee is fixed by the sponsor so that this is a demo and not a faucet.

scope.description: Optional label carried into the authorization object.

name: make_payment
